title: Wanderers Courtesy
description: Purchase Emeralds from the Wandering Trader with food and drink, and receive tips from them as they leave.
body: **Wanderers Courtesy** hopes to incentivize players to keep Wandering Traders around, by adding a new Purchase trade to them, allowing players to buy Emeralds for food and drink, as well as adding a "tipping" system in which the Wandering Trader and Trader Llamas drop Emeralds when they despawn.
